default.note: the boot state, surface vector: free camera, 6 h trail, stars + planets, everything else off

vector.note: marble, then back to the coastlines: the material swap-back must leave the default frame

marble.note: the shipped Blue Marble, its 2048 rung landed (the shader material, its maps and uniforms)

elements.note: the element geometry, the inertial frame, the constellations and R(+): the sky layers hung on the scene

follow.note: the camera over the sub-satellite point (the page boots in this mode, so the frame equals default)

dragged.note: free camera turned by a mouse drag (leaves follow): the cam0 lon/lat steps

site.note: the camera over Bangkok (the observer pin, its lock to the Earth)

pov.note: the view from the spacecraft: camera on the orbit, footprint ring and atmosphere rules

pov-lens.note: POV with the lens opened by 6 wheel notches (42 -> 70 degrees: the wheel is a lens there; the horizon comes into view)

zoomed.note: free camera pulled in by 8 wheel notches (4.2 -> 1.5 radii): marker scaling, near-camera cull of the catalogue

no-earth.note: the wire sphere instead of the planet and its atmosphere

site-svalbard.note: an observer moved by the form (the pin is rebuilt: siteMoved), then the site camera

in-view.note: the clock on the last pass's culmination: contact line, orange marker, footprint over the observer
